Note Update available: v0.10.1 -> v0.10.2
▏    Release notes: https://github.com/codewhale-hq/CodeWhale/releases/tag/v0.10.2
▏    Run /update install here (preview it with a bare /update), or codewhale update in a shell, then restart Codewhale.

Note Available hook events (use one of these as event = "..." in your [[hooks.hooks]] entry).
▏    Hooks are a TUI runtime feature: codewhale exec, the CLI dispatcher, the app-server,
▏    and the workflow tool do not fire them.
▏
▏    - session_start — fires once when the TUI launches
▏    - session_end — fires once on graceful shutdown
▏    - turn_end — fires after a turn completes (observer-only)
▏    - message_submit — fires before model dispatch; can transform or block submitted text
▏    - tool_call_before — fires before each tool call; can allow/deny/ask, rewrite input, add context
▏    - tool_call_after — fires after each tool call (observer-only)
▏    - mode_change — fires on Plan/Act/Operate transitions
▏    - on_error — fires on transport / capacity / tool errors
▏    - subagent_spawn — fires when a sub-agent starts (observer-only)
▏    - subagent_complete — fires when a sub-agent completes, fails, or is cancelled (observer-only)
▏    - shell_env — fires before each exec_shell; stdout KEY=VALUE lines are merged into its environment
▏    - session_idle — fires when the session settles back to idle after a turn or a wait (observer-only)
▏    - session_error — fires when a turn ends in a terminal failure; absorbed tool failures never fire it (observer-only)
▏    - waiting_for_user — fires when an approval prompt opens, a question is presented, or a goal continuation parks (observer-only)
▏    - session_busy — idle / waiting → in_progress
▏
▏    Only message_submit, tool_call_before, and shell_env can steer a turn.
▏    Observer-only means the result is ignored — the command still runs
▏    and can have any external side effect.
▏
▏    Full contract: docs/HOOKS.md
